summary: Spoken Dialogue Models (SDMs) typically share a speech-token space for generation and synthesis, leading to long autoregressive sequences and costly inference. Lower-rate speech tokenizers shorten sequences but may introduce compression-quality trade-offs and costly replacement without breaking this coupling.
takeaways: On bilingual speech-dialogue benchmarks, CoSTA achieves approximately 1.7times expanded speech-token generation speed, lower full-response latency, and higher throughput while preserving response quality.
Further experiments demonstrate cross-architecture transfer and complementarity to low-rate tokenization.
Lower-rate speech tokenizers shorten sequences but may introduce compression-quality trade-offs and costly replacement without breaking this coupling.
